copy.tagline: 自动执行 Apex27 平台上的重复操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Apex27 上处理重复性任务并希望自动化。
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive tasks on the Apex27 platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle repetitive tasks on Apex27 and want to automate them.

howto.what: Claude会变成Apex27任务助手。它能自动搜索所需工具、连接你的Apex27账号，并执行操作（如管理任务、运行工作流），无需手动配置。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude执行Apex27相关任务（例如“更新任务”、“运行工作流”）时触发。它会先搜索当前工具，确保连接有效后再执行。

say.text: 帮我自动化Apex27上的任务更新。
say.note: Claude会搜索工具并执行更新操作。
Claude会调用连接管理工具确认状态。
Claude会搜索Apex27工具并返回结果。

howto.what_en: Claude automates Apex27 tasks. It searches tools, connects to your account, and executes operations like managing tasks or running workflows, without manual config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to perform Apex27 tasks (e.g., 'update a task', 'run a workflow'). It first searches for current tools, then ensures connection is active before executing.

say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute the update.
Claude will call the connection tool to confirm.
Claude will search and return the list.
